evidence: Annotates legacy key and script retrieval interfaces across src/script/signingprovider.h, src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.h, and src/wallet/wallet.h with [[nodiscard]].
rationale: Adds `[[nodiscard]]` to key and script retrieval interfaces in `SigningProvider` and `ScriptPubKeyMan` to ensure callers do not ignore return values. While useful defensive hygiene to prevent using uninitialized or invalid out-parameters, it is an internal compiler-attribute refactor with no active wallet bug fix.
